title: Do not call her a racist: anti-Pauline Hanson strategists tell campaigners character attacks won’t work in Victoria
summary_full: Exclusive: Strategic rethink urges progressive activists to respectfully steer one-on-one conversations with One Nation supporters towards economic concernsFollow our Australia news live blog for latest updatesGet our new political email, free app or daily news podcastThe message from strategists was blunt: do not, however tempting, personally attack Pauline Hanson or call her a racist.The request has been made to progressive campaigners and unionists who have been asked to start one-on-one conversations with One Nation supporters before the Victorian election in November.Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
